extra: Also read /Users/siddharth/Developer/idea-to-shipped-work/state/skills/skills/engineering/ask-matt/PHASE-BOUNDARIES.md. Teach: tokens, what fills the window, `/context`, the Smart zone (~150k rule of thumb; quality not window size; 1M windows), `/clear` vs `/compact` vs auto-compact (and idle compaction), `/btw`, subagents as context isolation, Matt's phase-boundary order (continue, `/clear`, `/handoff`, subagent, `/compact`), and the `/handoff` Skill (user-invoked; four reasons to use it). A `meter` Scene fits here (zone: about where the Smart zone ends on the meter you draw). Site story: real material (the v1 build ran as one unbroken session that ended around 380k tokens; `/context` mid-build showed about 205k of 1M with a breakdown; the Main flow session was idle-compacted from about 247k to 31k tokens after `/to-tickets`; `/clear` was used between unrelated tasks before the build; never a manual `/compact` or `/handoff`). No clock times.
